items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the derived pushforward commutes with derived limits: Rf_*R lim K_n = R lim Rf_*K_n for an inverse system of objects of the derived category (statement lines 5149-5154). The main proof presents the derived limit through its defining product and shift, applies Rf_* and uses its compatibility with products (proof lines 5156-5175). The author then adds an alternate proof in the case where the site has enough points, checking the statement on stalks via the distinguished triangle defining the derived limit (proof lines 5178-5198). The non-formal content is the compatibility of the derived pushforward with products. The claim is H2: one argument with an alternative given by the author.
